display_name: LoRa W24 中心与原生边缘联合恢复
description: Jointly restore the center and native edges with two MAP-conditioned edge heads and a fixed ungated half readout.
authorization: Active LoRa and WiSig restoration research goal authorizes isolated component diagnostics.

code.environment: N607 fixed 7615e8e4 training archive and fixed W24 inference archive Python
code.cwd: original W24 DURA training archive for fit; original W24 reader archive for source inference

data.version: Native W24 1 MHz original Full and native_residual_w24_v1
data.representation: 8 chirps, 384 complex center samples + 48 native edge samples
data.contract_ref: Archived native W24 source release, data/source contract
data.validation_ref: Same parent Full and Residual raw ordered-prediction panel

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only fixed-training candidate; current packet IQ only and no input gate. Frozen source V evaluated separately. No target reads.

checkpoint.initialization: Scratch with archived matched center initialization and added native edge heads

sources.role: Fixed source-only W24 DURA actual complete 40,000 updates

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: fit-inputs.json and frozen check in w24_outer_objective_source.load_candidate
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Candidate reads only source IQ during optimization; earlier checkpoints evaluated only after freeze.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze at 40,000. Compare both routes and all scenes versus registered original half and same-weight center-only readout. Pair with the independent completed outer-objective control after both runs finish.

execution.gpu_policy: One eligible physical GPU selected by lower current utilization and remaining memory.
execution.stop_rule: Retain outputs and stop downstream on contract, objective, nonfinite fit or freeze / physical-pairing mismatches.

rows.method: Two W24 MAP-conditioned native boundary heads, one joint training loop
rows.seed_notes: Both arms reuse the archive source partition, receiver-sampling and perturbation generators. Source V panel seed is 2026112559; eval seed records frozen W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: 40000 steps, batch 16, 20000 fit U and 500 held U, followed by 300 fixed source V packets per route and seven views

notes: Center parameters have exactly same initial state as the independently running outer-objective cohort.
Joint-model center-only and center+edge always reuse one full forecast pass.
Paired outer-objective metrics can only be formed after both independent source prediction roots freeze.
